import subprocess
import sys

LIMIT = 8 * 1024 * 1024
PREFIX = ('{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[{"name":"aa","frames":[],'
          '"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],"events":[],"channels":'
          '[{"name":"e","parts":[')
SUFFIX = ']}]}'
PIECE = '{"case":null,"data":"'
INNER = 65000


def build(size):
    body = len(PREFIX) + len(SUFFIX)
    parts = []
    unit = len(PIECE) + INNER + 2  # + closing quote and comma
    while body + unit + len(PIECE) + 2 + 1 <= size:
        parts.append(PIECE + 'x' * INNER + '"')
        body += len(parts[-1]) + 1
    remainder = size - body - 1 - len(PIECE) - 2 - len(SUFFIX)
    if remainder < 0:
        remainder = 0
        parts.pop()
        body = len(PREFIX) + len(SUFFIX) + sum(len(p) + 1 for p in parts)
        remainder = size - body - 1 - len(PIECE) - 2 - len(SUFFIX)
    parts.append(PIECE + 'y' * remainder + '"')
    raw = PREFIX + ','.join(parts) + SUFFIX
    delta = size - len(raw)
    if delta:
        parts[-1] = PIECE + 'y' * (remainder + delta) + '"'
        raw = PREFIX + ','.join(parts) + SUFFIX
    assert len(raw) == size, (len(raw), size)
    assert raw.count('"y') >= 0
    return raw.encode()


for size in (LIMIT, LIMIT + 1):
    payload = build(size)
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', 'main.py'], input=payload,
                          capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project')
    print(size, len(payload), proc.returncode, proc.stdout[:40], proc.stderr[:120])
PYEOF
